parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: OwnerUserId
parameters.description: The UID of the account to which the resource belongs.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceDomain
parameters.description: The domain name of the resource. This parameter is available when you query FC or SAE resources.

parameters.name: ResourceFunction
parameters.description: The name of the function. This parameter is available when you query FC resources.

parameters.name: ResourceInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource instance.

parameters.name: ResourceInstanceName
parameters.description: The name of the instance that is added to WAF.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: ResourceName
parameters.description: The name of the resource instance.

parameters.name: ResourceProduct
parameters.description:
The cloud service to which the resource belongs. By default, instances of Application Load Balancer (ALB), Microservices Engine (MSE), Function Compute (FC), and Serverless App Engine (SAE) are returned. Valid values:

- **alb**: ALB

- **mse**: MSE

- **fc**: FC

- **sae**: SAE

- **ecs**: Elastic Compute Service (ECS)

- **clb4**: Classic Load Balancer (CLB) that uses TCP

- **clb7**: CLB that uses HTTP or HTTPS

- **nlb**: Network Load Balancer (NLB)

> Each cloud service supports different regions. If you specify this parameter, make sure the region you specify for the ResourceRegionId parameter supports this service. Otherwise, the query may fail.

parameters.name: ResourceRegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region where the resource resides. For more information, see the "Regions and supported products" section in this topic.

> Each cloud service supports different regions. If you specify the ResourceProduct parameter, make sure the region you specify for this parameter supports that service. Otherwise, the query may fail.

parameters.name: ResourceRouteName
parameters.description: The name of the route. This parameter is available when you query MSE resources.
